description.value: A full-service fishing resort on Sheridan Lake along BC's famous paved 'Fishing Highway 24,' offering pull-through and back-in RV sites plus cabins, boat rentals, a tackle shop, beach, and swimming; heavily oriented around trophy rainbow trout but open year-round for ice fishing and snowmobiling.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website loaded fully and provides the primary evidence base. The resort offers cabins, pull-through RV sites, and back-in sites along with boat rentals, a tackle shop, and a fish cleaning station on Sheridan Lake; no cyclist-specific amenities (hiker/biker sites, showers, laundry, tools, fuel) are mentioned anywhere on the site. Reservations are confirmed via a prominent 'BOOK NOW' widget powered by ResNexus. OSM had no phone number; the website supplies (250) 593-4611, and the address matches OSM exactly.
concerns: OSM record contains no phone number; (250) 593-4611 sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate, actively operating campground with back-in and pull-through sites on a scenic lake along Highway 24 in the Cariboo; a viable overnight stop for cycle tourists riding the Fishing Highway corridor.

wow_evidence: full-service fishing resort on Sheridan Lake
